Op. 7005R52 ELECTRIC EXTERIOR REAR VIEW MIRROR UPPER REFLECTOR (ONE) LEFT OR RIGHT - R.R.

1. Undo the bolts fixing the upper reflector adjustment motor.

2. Release the lower cover for the motor housing.

3. Mark the motor electrical connectors and disconnect them.

4. Remove the motor.

Refitting

- Close the compartment housing the connectors using the special cover.

- Fasten the motor to the mirror tightening the fixing bolts.
